purpose: Pre-registered near-clone-group split for AMR task evaluation; frozen before model results

rules.unit: drug x BioSample x versioned assembly; one row per unit
rules.group: near_clone_group; whole group in one partition
rules.source_note: source components may cross partitions by user decision (D0-28); documented in limitations
rules.conflicts: mixed S/R within a clone group flagged; primary analysis excludes them
rules.partitioning: 70/10/20 by group count, deterministic seeded greedy; min_groups enforced
